title: E-Commerce VA Operations Master Suite & KPI Dashboard
summary: Consolidated multi-sheet operational workbook connecting product research, catalog listing audits, dynamic inventory reordering, and order fulfillment queues into an executive command dashboard.
problem: E-commerce founders and store managers struggle with fragmented spreadsheets that fail to communicate across operational silos, resulting in mismatched inventory numbers and blind spots in store health.
whatIDid: Architected a unified master workbook consolidating four core virtual assistant operational workflows across synchronized, color-coded functional tabs.

Engineered an executive summary KPI dashboard aggregating cross-sheet metrics using formula linkages (=COUNTA, =COUNTIF) to display total researched SKUs, pending listing audits, safety stock alerts, and open SLA escalations.
Applied executive styling standards including dark slate headers, frozen view panes, clean number formats (currency, percentages, dates), and soft-tinted conditional badge states.
Documented complete operational assumptions, column definitions, and formula methodologies on a dedicated onboarding sheet for seamless client handover.
result: Delivered an all-in-one operational toolkit that bridges the gap between daily store tasks and executive decision-making, cutting cross-sheet navigation time and standardizing routine VA workflows.
